commonPrompt:
Create realistic, production-quality Korean mobile app UI with clear hierarchy, strong typography, purposeful spacing, professional restrained polish. Use-case ui-mockup. This is one focused confirmation screen for Dooit, not a feature inventory. One app frame only. Target CSS viewport 390 x 844 portrait, same natural aspect ratio, sharp readable Korean. Current date anchor Sunday 2026-10-25. Visible schedule date 2026-10-25, start 14:00, end 14:30. No other invented dates. Preserve hard product constraints: mobile-first Dooit white surfaces, blue primary #2563EB, dark text #0F172A, secondary neutral #4B5563, subtle gray field borders, outline icons from the existing visual language, quiet spacing. Body 14-16 CSS pixels, headings18-22, button visual/touch height44 minimum; do not enlarge all typography to fill frame. No yellow/amber warning surface, no brown stroke, no black focus outline, no thick borders, no glossy gradients, no illustrations, no invented features. Focus appearance, when relevant, is a restrained blue ring for keyboard only. No device bezel/body/notch/Dynamic Island/status bar/clock/battery/home indicator/browser chrome/device mask/shadow. Render app content only edge to edge.
Image reference roles: first attached JPEG is the actual existing basic editor and is the primary structural reference; second JPEG is the existing ugly warning state, a PROBLEM TO REPLACE, never copy its yellow banner or stacked boxed warning; third PNG is the previously approved read-only detail source, for overall Dooit white/blue identity and header hierarchy, not for copying its enlarged pixel scale or date. Do not invent a large title checkbox in the editor.
Preserve this editing context behind or around the confirmation: same nearly full-height white edit sheet with small handle at top, header blue goal dot + '토익 900점 받기' path, simple close X. Edit heading '할 일 수정'. Actual unsaved title field contains '토익 시험 접수 준비'. Type selector '할 일 / 일정 / 아이디어', with 일정 selected. Date '2026-10-25', '종일 일정' switch off, start '14:00', end '14:30'; a quiet '추가 정보' disclosure. Avoid gratuitous copy. Do not recreate every field as a separate large card. Calm aligned field groups with subtle neutral field boundaries, and a single subdued segmented type group. The context must be recognizably the same existing editor, not a new task detail page or new app shell.
Layout tools priority: spacing/alignment/type hierarchy first, subtle tint second, borders only where needed for input affordance, very minimal shadow only to communicate a floating decision. No cards within cards. Output only a single cohesive primary screen, no collage, no option numbers or presentation labels, no explanatory annotations outside app content.
All exact confirmation copy must be correct Korean: title '변경 내용을 버릴까요?' and supporting message '저장하지 않은 변경 내용이 사라져요.' Buttons are '계속 작성' (primary blue, safe/default action) and '변경 내용 버리기' (secondary red text, never the dominant solid red action). Other editor controls are inactive while a confirmation is visible. Preserve entered content; no percent progress or motivation banners added.
